name: [NWI] HubSpot Companies -> BC Customers (daily, update only)

parameters.content:
## NWI - HubSpot Companies -> BC Customers (daily, UPDATE ONLY): set up before publishing
1. Connect credentials: **HubSpot Service Key account** and **Business Central – NWI Group (client credentials)**. Confirm no "not connected" warning on any node.
2. Settings -> Error Workflow: set the shared error handler (not set in this file). Settings -> Timezone: Australia/Sydney. Runs at 03:00, after the BC -> HubSpot syncs, so HubSpot wins when both changed.
3. BC web service **Customer_Card** must be published and writable.
4. Only HubSpot companies that already have `business_central_id` are synced. Nothing is ever created in BC.
5. HubSpot values must be valid in BC (segment, sub segment, responsibility center, location code, ABN, country). A record BC rejects is skipped and the run carries on, so check the execution list for failed *Update BC* items.
6. **Workflow Config** holds the lookback window (24h before the run), batch size and the BC-field -> HubSpot-property map.

**What it does:** finds HubSpot companies modified in the 24 hours before the run, reads their BC customers (50 per call), and updates only the BC fields whose value differs. HubSpot wins. A blank in HubSpot never clears BC. Blocked customers are skipped. Posting groups, payment terms and the primary contact are never touched. Safe to re-run.

nodes.name: Every Day
nodes.notes: Runs once a day at 03:00 (set the workflow timezone to Australia/Sydney). Production runs only - publish the workflow.

nodes.name: Workflow Config
nodes.notes: lookbackHours: how far back from the run time to look (24 = the last 24 hours). matchProperty: HubSpot property holding the BC number. fieldMap: BC field -> HubSpot property.

nodes.name: Find Changed HubSpot Companies
nodes.notes: Read-only search (POST is only the HubSpot search convention): every company modified in the window that has a BC number, 100 per page (all pages are read).

nodes.name: Build BC Read Batches
nodes.notes: Groups the changed records into batches (batchSize each). No changed records = no output, so the run ends here.

nodes.name: Read BC Customer Details
nodes.notes: One call per batch: the current BC values, so only real differences are written.

nodes.name: Build Customer Updates
nodes.notes: One item per BC record that needs an update, with only the differing fields. HubSpot wins; blanks are never sent.

nodes.name: Update BC Customer
nodes.notes: One PATCH per changed record (BC has no multi-record update). Update only: never creates. If BC rejects a value the record is skipped and the run carries on.
